pos.text: I am going to start by stating that I actually really like this game. What I have do is air a grievance though. This game hasn't been updated in over 3 years at this point, and it has things that were never implemented but were clearly meant to slot in. Either take out the parts that are never going to get added in (Belt and Gloves I believe) or finally put them in. I would also gladly pay for a full content DLC at this point with how cheap the base game is. There just isn't enough in the game as is.

Not my cup of tea, but it's well made and has a lot of heart. It was like catnip to my wife. 

Regardless, good mechanics, good design. and a good recommendation.
Always fun to go back to, wish they had continued to add other classes or a second game. The blocked out quiver always made me want more.
It's great but I'm not sure why. The bad reviews are pretty accurate, but I love the game anyway.

This should definitely be filed under "incremental," so if you have the "number go up" mindset, you'll have a great time with this game.  Conversely, if you hate that kind of genre, you won't like this.  It's really that simple.  The game isn't deep, it's a bit of meta-management to make number go up bigerer and that's it.  I personally loved it - twice.

Not a bad game, but for me gets repetitive a bit fast.

Your character auto-moves and auto-battles, your actions are just to construct/modify the loop he's going through, trying to get a balance between getting enough ennemies so you get ressources to scale, and not getting overrun. It's less boring that it sounds, and gets quite addictive. But then after 1 or 2 hours, when you leave the game, I don't feel like I had a lot of fun.

You build the world around you as you loop through a track. Every loop enemies get stronger and you get better gear as well. 

It all fine and dandy when you get a general idea of things. Dont spam enemy spawners like crazy, dont stack them, give breathing room, Unless rng ♥♥♥♥♥ on you try to get a build going, etc.


It dumb as hell though because the jump from one loop to the next is so exponential that one loop youre basically untouchable and have full health by the end of loop to, being killed not even halfway through the next. Its SO infuriating.  The problem is this is a resource/building game and you cant progress without resources. 

You lose 70% on death, or mid loop retreat. The resources aren't just get one of this or that. Its gather 10+ of this tiny resource to make !1! normal resource. Its idiotic.

reviews.title: A New All Time Classic!
reviews.text:
For a game that can be played with just one touch, there is nothing more perfect than this for mobile whilst offering such deep and interesting an experience. I passed up this game for a while, for unknown reasons having the wrong impression of it (perhaps partially from the generic name). This is ultimately a strategy game, even really, a board game.

What defines this game is that, whilst the hero travels around the board, you must strategically choose what challenges to place in their path, balancing risk and reward to help the hero grow stronger. These challenges are drawn with some degree of randomness that you will influence by your placements. All of the things you can place on the board have (usually hidden) reactions and combinations with each other. I have beaten the game once so far and have not found all the interactions yet. [I see those hints in the credits ;) ] All of this

reviews.title: Only a trial
reviews.text: Can’t believe this game wants me to pay one time to unlock the full game. Why didn’t they slow your progress down and force you to buy gems to speed up building progress and play ads every time you loop around the map. I need roadblocks in my game so I lose interest in them after I am forced to drop 10 .99 every day to speed up my building progress. I don’t think the developers understand how gaming works today. You make a game then you strip out all the features and put them behind multiple paywalls and let the player spend small amounts of money until it accumulates to hundreds of dollars then you stop plaiting the game for a week and your so far behind you have to spend more money to catch back up. Instead these geniuses are asking for just one purchase at the INSANE price of $7. You saw that correctly fokes. A game with 20-40 hours of content for 10% of the  price of a AAA game with

reviews.title: Just great! Ton of content for one low price!
reviews.text: I just wanna say how shocked I am by how much is packed into this tiny download. You can quickly tell this title was created by people who love what they are doing. Next I want to say how thankful I am for growing up when I did.. these people posting 1 star reviews due to having to simply pay for a product should honestly be ashamed. Where does that kind of entitlement come from? Their parents? How hard is it to understand that people have worked hard to bring this game to us. Spent time away from their families and loved ones. Stayed up late into the night, giving us the fruit of their blood sweat and tears. Why wouldn’t it be fair to ask for compensation for a provided service? For those of you STILL complaining that this title costs money you should really just be ashamed it this point. It’s a great game. It deserves our praise and our money. Devs thank you all for your hard work!

reviews.title: Great little gem of a game
reviews.text: This game is very addicting, invoking the ‘just one more turn’ mentality. It’s the perfect game for mobile since you can spend minutes on it, or hours if you want. There’s no mobile dark patterns design in here, just a game for the sake of having fun playing. You get a free trial which is the perfect amount of trial to get to know the game, then a small one-time fee to unlock the full game which is still cheaper than the cheapest freemium tier currency purchase on almost every other mobile game these days. The only critique I have is that some of the stats are a bit underpowered. Vampirism drops off in usefulness very fast, and some talents are giving you like +3 hp in turn 5 when enemies are starting to hit for like 20.

reviews.title: Excellent game!
reviews.text: I love this game so much. Third time I've bought it now, and I'm happy to play it some more. I wish I could transfer my save from PC over, but oh well. The only issue I have is that iCloud/Game Center save syncing doesn't work at all. I've tried so many things. Rebooting each device, making sure there isn't a conflicting save on the other device, multiple connection points, giving it several hours to ensure it syncs, copying the save to another slot and seeing if that kicks it in, deleting a fresh save on the other device in hopes of maybe "clearing" space for the save. So far, nothing at all has worked.

reviews.title: A wonderful game
reviews.text: Overall it’s an absolutely amazing game that you should definitely play. The only reason I give it 4 instead of 5 stars: the rng can sometimes really really really screw your run, which is completely understandable in these types of games. But when that happens several runs in a row I pretty much just totally lose interest. It would be AWESOME if the rng could be tweaked so that certain cards would have a higher or lower percent of showing depending on other cards. Like for instance I HATE the village and wheat fields like a passion because my hand will fill up completely full of wheat fields. But I’ll never get a single village card. So the wheat fields are totally unplayable and therefore deleting cards that I WANT to keep. Beyond frustrating. So when that just keeps happening: I’m done.

reviews.title: Perfect iPad Game
reviews.text: I’ve played this game on the computer and loved it, but it’s even better on a mobile device. The gameplay is simple but addictive, with a semi-random nature reminiscent of roguelikes, but with enough consistent progress that you always feel like you succeeded in something, even if you die. It also has a charming setting and story, and it’s as well suited to a 15 minute game as it is to a multi-hour binge. The only thing I wish it had was an expansion, DLC, or sequel - but there’s plenty of content and replayability here! Easy 5/5

reviews.title: There’s nothing like it
reviews.text: Loop Hero is inventing a genre, the way Slay The Spire created roguelite deck builders. Perhaps not the first, but first to get it right. It doesn’t seem like much at first, but give it some time. As you build out your base and learn how to strategically place your map tiles, the game comes alive. The description says you don’t control combat—but by your gear selections and how you arrange the path, you absolutely do. 5 Stars for gameplay, 4 for graphics which I hope are better on a sequel, but turn on the pixel shader, it helps a lot. This is a unique, well designed game I will be playing for a long time.

reviews.title: A real game for your phone!
reviews.text:
It’s so rare these days to get games you can just buy and not get pestered by ads or micro transactions. The free version is just a demo but you buy the full game and it’s the full game no more gotchas. 

The gameplay itself is solid, look it up as the game was a proper PC game before it was ported for the phone. My only gripe is placing tiles sometimes I just want to click on the card to remind myself of its full stats and end up accidentally placing it in a terrible spot but after awhile that’s a rare occurrence.

reviews.title: Great game, one time price!
reviews.text: Found this game originally on the computer. I was ecstatic to see it on the tablet. Very much a hidden gem. This is the first of this game type I have played and I have fallen in love with this gameplay. Pick a class, start a loop, build your challenge, and continue till you can’t. Then bring back the loot and upgrade your camp to unlock story and more classes. I personally use the game wiki to know which cards change others (I know, I am a cheat). Join the fun!

reviews.title: Turning up the speed makes this game awesome
reviews.text:
A unique twist on tower defense, deck building, auto battling, and rogue likes, all in one fun and addictive package.
The trial version gives you plenty of content to decide if this game is for you.
The default settings might feel a bit slow at first, but you have the option to speed up the combat and walking elements, which improves the gameplay a ton and makes it a lot snappier and exciting.

reviews.title: Great game!
reviews.text: I’ve had this on PC for a while and was hoping for a mobile port, finally my dreams come true 😭 I’m not sure why people are leaving negative feedback based on a very clear description, most PC ports cost money on mobile. This game is well worth the price, I’ve gotten a lot of hours out of it on PC. I love the QOL additions like the arrows pointing exactly where your card is under your finger so you know where it will be placed, great port!

reviews.title: Absolutely Outstanding
reviews.text: Didn’t know what to expect going into this but the game definitely did not disappoint. The art style is perfect, very clean with a nice use of colors, the world the game takes place in is interesting and the mechanics of having to rebuild the world piece by piece and the way it was implemented was unique. I’ll probably end up buying it on steam rather than just sticking to my phone.

reviews.title: Could use some fine tuning
reviews.text:
Overall the game itself is great. If you liked it on PC then you know what to expect. 

I would like some more control over sizes and the overlay of the stats. While they are important on a phone they take up a lot of space and could easily be something that is able to be minimized.

reviews.title: A Diamond in the rough
reviews.text:
Literally stumbled on this game and have been enjoying playing through it since. 

Excellent mechanics, great replayability and charming graphics make this game a truly unique and enjoyable experience.

The only reason why I’m giving it 4 stars instead of 5 is that for some reason the sound doesn’t work. It’s a real bummer because I’d imagine that the soundtrack is banging but I wouldn’t know. Hopefully it’s fixed eventually.

reviews.title: The Start
reviews.text: I was waiting forever for this game to come out the preview just kept me hooked to the point that I immediately played it on release if you plan to install this look forward to the good graphics, story, and combat to keep you immersed. (P.S You gotta pay for the full thing but whatever I’ll buy it later.)

reviews.title: Awesome game, rough port for mobile
reviews.text:
Some of the text is extremely hard to read, especially if you turn on the larger text settings. 

Various UI elements are in weird places and can’t be moved, cards can be accidentally dropped at the bottom of the screen if you don’t drag them all the way back to the row back in your hand (and even then it won’t work). 

Vague descriptions on items make for a quite confusing start, forcing you to look it up on google even after you unlock the encyclopedia (which again you’ll need to read the tiny text through. 

Still a very fun game and the devs did a good job getting it to mobile, there’s just some room for QoL improvements.

reviews.title: Perfect for Mobile
reviews.text: I have been playing Loop Hero since its initial release. Super addictive game. I have played on PC and Switch. The IOS version is fantastic. It has been optimized for touch controls, and feels like it was designed specifically for the iPad. This is the perfect “Just one more round,” type of game. Well done.

reviews.title: I Really Love This Game
reviews.text: I want to give it 5 stars so badly, but as of the past day or two, the app is unresponsive, at first, it would happen mid game, so the game would keep going but I wouldn’t be able to control anything, but now I can’t get past the main screen. I’m only writing this to bring attention to this issue in case it has not yet been detected, hope I can update it and keep playing soon!! Thanks for a great game!

reviews.title: Loop love hardcore
reviews.text: Thank you for an amazing game that is unique and takes so much stamina to get through. The struggle, strategy and endless nights toiling over card variations and heroes made it so much fun. There would be times I wanted to throw my phone across the room, but I reincarnated and slowly began again. BRAVO!

reviews.title: Decent
reviews.text: The game is ok, basically not bad and not good, average. Art style is extremely basic but it works and I actually kind of dig it. The gameplay loop is where things get stale. There’s just not enough to keep it interesting long term. Need more mobs, more buildings, more interesting equipment. I’ll check back in a few months to see how the things went. 2.5/5 as is.

reviews.title: Excellent casual strategy RPG
reviews.text: Has surprising depth and complexity for what is seemingly a simple game at the start. The UI could use a bit more polish to make certain game  mechanics more clear such as what increases found item inventory and how they impact fighting but overall a pretty fun and deep game

reviews.title: Can you fix this?
reviews.text: After I build the building and have the encyclopedia, the game just crashed quickly. I have tried a few times but failed. Can you fix the bug? I really like this game.

reviews.title: Always Should Have Been On Mobile
reviews.text: Played and beat this a couple of years back on PC. Defiantly recommend, works excellently for mobile and feels like it should have been here from the start!

reviews.title: Super fun
reviews.text: You’ll know pretty quickly whether this is your kind of game. And I like how much is left for players to discover through experiment and accident. Too many games do too much hand holding.

reviews.title: Amazing Mobile Port
reviews.text: I played the original PC release to a full completion and pounced on the ability to play it again, and have been elated to find the game has been ported and made to mobile near flawlessly!

Edit: You can say all you want developers but it’s still extremely misleading. I was familiar with the game so I didnt bother reading the description nor did many others. You should have put (trial) in the title or something. I will be removing this game from my steam wishlist as well because of this.

reviews.title: Better than most mobile games
reviews.text: There’s a lot more to this than most mobile games and no predatory monetization. It really is worth every penny and if you’re on the fence I say go for it!

reviews.title: Amazing game
reviews.text: This game can never get boring to me, so much to do, building your own little world and seeing how far as you can get, I’ve been waiting for it to come to mobile so I can play on the go

reviews.title: Easily one of my favorite roguelike deck builders
reviews.text: The world is interesting and the gameplay is simple yet addictive. I like the excitement of rng stats but it never feels unfair or a pain to deal with. Artwork is so classic and pretty and I enjoy my little town

reviews.title: One of the best, most unique, and genius-ly made games Ive ever played
reviews.text: Absolutely incredible game. The thought behind each and every pixel and mechanic is amazing. Third time I’ve purchased this gem 😎 buy it. Well done as always devs

reviews.title: This game made me play mobile games
reviews.text: There is so much creativity in this game , a breath of fresh air from all the identical mobile games with their stamina and energy bs,thank you for creating an amazing game

reviews.title: Best casual or non-casual
reviews.text: I tried it first on pc, but on mobile is even better! It smooths out some of the tedious loading and pc only stuff, 11/10, totally addicted to the mobile version

reviews.title: Exact Port
reviews.text: Performs exactly as it does on my Switch, with the exception of touch controls. No bugs so far, with a few hours in. I have no complaints, and am not surprised by a playdigious game.

reviews.title: Fun
reviews.text: Even though this game released a while ago I downloaded the free trial this morning. About 10 minutes later I bought the game 😂. It’s a very fun and interesting adventure rpg rogue like dungeon master. 😀

reviews.title: Fantastic!
reviews.text: This game wasn’t made for mobile at first, but it should’ve been.  It’s just as perfect as it’s console/PC predecessor, and it’s finally here on iOS!  So happy to finally have this.

reviews.title: Interesting
reviews.text: Definitely a well made game, quality is there along with attention to detail. The story is intriguing, what happened? Who’s left? Idk, but we’ll find out.

reviews.text:
Interesting game; well suited for its medium.
Was disappointed to find it couldn’t be played on the AVP though controls should map.
Will happily buy if made available on AVP.

reviews.title: Build your own dungeon
reviews.text:
Unique game with a nice art style. Spent plenty of nightly hours on this game leveling up my dungeon and camp. 

Would like to see an expansion in the future as I’m half way done and would like to play more. Or similar games in this style :)

reviews.title: I’d rather have a genuine premium game than FTP!
reviews.text: I love this game. It’s addictive and has great pixelated graphics. I have no problem forming over for a premium title with complete gameplay and an engaging story. Playdigious strikes gold again.

reviews.title: Unfinished
reviews.text: The game is a really fun concept, but it quickly becomes apparent that they make you pay for a game that is blatantly unfinished. This is most obvious in the equipment screen which has slots for 2 types of items that were never put into the game. There is zero replay value for what is here and the fact that you have to pay for an incomplete game is terrible.

reviews.title: No other game like it! Get it NOW!!!
reviews.text: Instead of saying, “Save the forgotten world,” it should say, “What is going on?” That’s what I really loved about this game, the wonder. Slowly piecing together what is going on.

reviews.title: Good game with unplayable issues
reviews.text:
Great game and I happily paid for the full version only to be disappointed by some issues that sometimes makes picking up the game a frustrating waste of time. 

The first problem is that the games doesn't save progress accurately. After finish a level in a play session, the game doesn't save, so next time you play you have to beat same level again.

The second problem is the game often lags and crashes so it's unplayable. 

Wish I could get a refund

reviews.title: Addictive but flawed
reviews.text:
The gameplay loop of this game is very addictive and great for mobile but the lack of explanation it gives for resources and how to acquire them is incredibly annoying. You can’t even hover over a resource to see what it’s called, all you have to go on is a blurry sprite. It wasn’t until I watched a tips and tricks video on YouTube that I realized there’s an encyclopedia you unlock associated with one of the last buildings you gain the ability to add to your town. 
Why would the encyclopedia not be available to players from the beginning to they know how to acquire the resources they need to build the next buildings in their town? 
Hoping some updates comes soon that improve the user experience and I can recommend this game to more people.
